dialogues.speaker: Sango
dialogues.text: A family member lost in an attack by an unknown deity... What an interesting case. It's definitely a worthwhile case for our agency.

dialogues.speaker: Sango
dialogues.text: Hmm... You obtained some clues from meeting them? That makes things easier. Tell me what you know then.

dialogues.speaker: Sango
dialogues.text: ...Hey, come closer. Best not to let anyone eavesdrop on critical information.
